# Nehemiah 4 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Nehemiah 4 (23 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.2 — "feeble" vs. "pathetic"
- **EMET:** "feeble" (*ha-amelallim*) / **LOGOS:** "feeble" / **PNEUMA:** "pathetic"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "feeble" — Hebrew *amelal* means withered or feeble; "pathetic" imports too much modern contempt.

---

## V.6 — "had a mind to work" vs. "had a heart to work"
- **EMET:** "had a-heart to-work" / **LOGOS:** "had a mind to work" / **PNEUMA:** "were determined to work"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "had a heart to work" — Hebrew uses *lev* (heart), the seat of will in Hebrew anthropology. "Mind" shifts to a Western cognitive frame; "determined" loses the idiom.

---

## V.23 — textual difficulty in final clause
- **EMET:** "each his-weapon and the-water" / **LOGOS:** "each kept his weapon at hand" / **PNEUMA:** "we kept our weapons with us at all times"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "each kept his weapon at hand" — The Hebrew *shilcho ha-mayim* is textually obscure; this rendering captures the clear sense of constant readiness.

---

*— SOPHIA*
